title: Scalar extension of ordinary quotient presentations with unit coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, finite coefficient fields E and L over Q_l, an embedding iota, and a scheme Y. Let A be normalized coefficient extension systems [stage3-pur-scalar-cochain-evaluation], ME and ML ordinary quotient models [def-trf-completion-unit-models], rho a unit-normalized evaluation of A, and association a normalized finite scalar associator. For any additive sequence scalar functor F equal to A.scalar.model.E and any complex P, suppose a:ME(P) isomorphic to C has finite comparisons kappa satisfying evaluation(a) followed by kappa equals the prescribed ME finite evaluation. Then F(C) is isomorphic to ML(ordinaryScalar(P)) as an entire strict sequence complex, and its finite evaluation sends the scalar unit on kappa inverse(1 tensor x) to 1 tensor (1 tensor x) for every quotient level, degree and local section x. The exact section types and HEq convention are those of [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. No flatness or pullback is assumed.

proof.text: Compose ordinary completed scalar extension with finite L reduction. The completed coefficient projection triangle and uniqueness of left adjoints give its association to direct finite scalar extension; the adjunction unit equation proves normalization on 1 tensor (1 tensor x). Linearity gives the formula for arbitrary finite scalars. Quotient unit successor compatibility then identifies the actual successor under these coordinates with integralScalarTransition. Compare this with the already proved successor for sequence scalar extension of ME(P), and use the strict sequence gluing construction to obtain an isomorphism scalar(ME(P)) to ML(ordinaryScalar(P)) on complexes. Naturality of the scalar unit, the presentation equation, and the two finite association formulas prove the nested unit formula for this isomorphism.

theorem scalarOrdinaryPresentationCoordinates (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems l E L ι Y)
    (ME : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E Y)
    (ML : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l L Y)
    (ρ : ∀ n, A.scalar.model.E ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L Y n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E)
    (hρ : IsCoefficientScalarEvaluationUnit l E L ι Y A ρ)
    (association : ∀ n, scalarReductionExtension l E Y n ⋙ (A.levels n).model.E ≅
      integralScalarReduction l E L ι Y n)
    (hassociation : IsCoefficientExtensionAssociation l E L ι Y A association)
    (F : coefficientSequenceModules l E Y ⥤ coefficientSequenceModules l L Y)
    [F.Additive] (hF : A.scalar.model.E = F)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (a : (ME.quotient l E Y).obj P ≅ C)
    (κ : ∀ n, ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
      (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)
    (hκ : ∀ n,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
        κ n = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (ME.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).app P) :
    ∃ v : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
      (ML.quotient l L Y).obj
        (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X i).val.obj U)
        (y : (F.obj (C.X i)).val.obj (op (n, U.unop))),
        HEq y ((A.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app (C.X i)).val.app
          (op (n, U.unop)) (integralComparisonSequenceSection l E Y (C.X i) n U
            (((κ n).inv.f i).val.app U
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E Y n (P.X i) U 1 x)))) →
        (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L Y n).map (v.hom.f i) ≫
            (ML.evaluation n).hom.app ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).obj (P.X i))).val.app
          U (coefficientEvaluationSection l L Y (F.obj (C.X i)) n U y)) =
        unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l L Y n
          ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι Y).obj (P.X i)) U 1
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι Y (P.X i) U 1 x)
